data.body: Gerrit PS2 default suite exposed two Linux-only test-fixture defects: the provider matrix included /usr/bin (where gh is installed), and the strict-delivery subprocess inherited pytest's autouse REBAR_ROOT sandbox instead of its disposable checkout. CI supplied RED evidence on 3 Linux versions. Fixed the fixtures without weakening production: isolated PATH now contains only explicit bash/git/fake-rebar; strict delivery pins REBAR_ROOT to its test checkout. Exact six cases GREEN, expanded runner/provider group 67 passed, lint/typecheck/raw-git gate/diff check green. Amended same Change-Id, fetched origin/main (0 behind), pushed PS3.
